text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) will be the first stockholder in the privatisation of Macedonian Telecommunications with an investment of $42.5 million. Macedonia's telecom is estimated at $700 to $800 million.
- Gasoline price not expected to increase, said Macedonian government spokesman.
- The government coalition will survive despite Albanian PDP party announcements of its possible disintegration, said the government spokesman.

- The United States will continue to support the constructive policy of the republic of Macedonia which is the source of stability in this region, said U.S. ambassador to the United Nations Bill Richardson in Skopje. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
